verdict.rationale: Devin's MCP integration explicitly documents scheduling support: 'set up schedules' and 'Supports cron expressions for recurring schedules, one-time scheduling, notification preferences, and agent selection,' confirming recurring job scheduling is a first-party capability. However, this is documented only via the MCP tool interface rather than a dedicated first-class scheduling UI, and there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of this specific feature working in practice. Missing for 10: independent verification of scheduling reliability, deeper documentation on the native (non-MCP) scheduling UX.
